missing_evidence: Original discovery has 1000 pre-action physical states but no local terminal endpoint, warmstarts or integrations; only 999 adjacent poststates can be derived without reconstruction.

Later independent episodes retain terminal_state, warmstarts/integrations and their terminal values, costs and velocities in the source teacher NPZs; these are bound here, not duplicated in train/validation targets.
Validation is held out of W1 fitting, but is historical development evidence, not a newly blinded population sample.
Recorded-teacher versus fresh-reset student performance gaps are descriptive and unpaired unless reset contexts are explicitly matched.

hash_contracts.arrays: SHA256 of original contiguous array bytes; shape and dtype are separate descriptors
hash_contracts.fit_data: Cast matrix to contiguous float32; SHA256(default JSON [shape,dtype] followed by array bytes)

w1_source.scope: Selected sealed W1 input NPZs and metadata only. Original array/container bytes preserved; no historical raw/ledger or checkpoint read, actor prediction, optimizer operation or simulator reconstruction.
